LanguageData.Megamod_DrugGeneration_EnabledHelp: Show Generate in the native drug-policy manager. Review and edit a preview before creating a new policy.
LanguageData.Megamod_DrugGeneration_PreferenceHelp: Apply stores this percentage for new or reset previews. Open previews become out of date. Existing policies keep their values.
LanguageData.Megamod_DrugGeneration_ToleranceHelp: Apply stores Any or a numeric limit for new or reset previews. Any is unrestricted; numeric 100% is a limit. When tolerance support is off or unavailable, refreshed previews use Any while retaining this preference.
LanguageData.Megamod_DrugGeneration_InvalidThreshold: Enter a finite percentage from 0 to 100.
LanguageData.Megamod_DrugGeneration_InvalidTolerance: Choose Any or a numeric tolerance from 0% to 100%.
